disposition_reason: Table 1 gives one lead, cadmium, chromium and nickel value for each of four chocolate brands, but the printed mg/g unit is implausible, so values are flagged and not converted.

study.design: small market survey of chocolate brands
study.market: one supermarket, Hadejia metropolis, Jigawa State, Nigeria
study.method: flame AAS (AAS 460) after hot-plate wet digestion with HNO3/H2O2 (1:1) at 80 C
study.qa: reagent blank only; no CRM or recovery

findings.locator: Table 1, row BC, column Pb, p. 1543
findings.integrity_flag: Unit label mg/g implies 50 mg/kg Pb, implausible for chocolate and inconsistent with the cited comparison data; true unit (possibly mg/kg or mg/L of digest) cannot be determined
findings.notes: Coded brand bought at one supermarket in Hadejia; samples oven-dried at 70 C before digestion; triplicate digests, single value printed. value_ugkg withheld because of the unit conflict.
